fan_analyst.note: Hittin' Season, Phillies Talk, and the Philly Show all celebrate the hot streak and elite rotation but flag Aiden Miller's back injury, Bohm's slump, and the 0-10 record vs. lefties as real concerns.

radio_populist.note: WIP High Hopes host is energized by the gritty comeback win and the team's sense of urgency under Mattingly, while venting hard about Brad Keller and noting Bohm is 'unplayable.'

themes.name: Rotation Resurrection
themes.sample: From worst ERA in baseball under the old regime to best in the last seven games — Sanchez's eight-inning gem and Wheeler's encouraging return have the pitching staff looking like a legitimate October weapon again.

themes.name: Bohm Bottoming Out
themes.sample: Third base has become a genuine crisis: Bohm is being called 'unplayable' and 'dreadful,' Mattingly is pinch-hitting for him in key spots, and there is no clear long-term solution with Aiden Miller still not swinging a bat.

themes.name: Aiden Miller Alarm
themes.sample: The team's top prospect has yet to pick up a bat in early May due to a recurring back issue, drawing ominous comparisons to David Wright and Andrew Painter and raising fears about a lost development year.

themes.name: Mattingly Passing the Test
themes.sample: When Bryce Harper publicly lobbied for Stott to play every day against lefties, Mattingly held his ground, played Sosa, and got the biggest hit of the game — earning credibility as a manager who won't be steamrolled by star players.

themes.name: Harper in MVP Mode
themes.sample: With nine home runs, a slugging percentage not seen since his MVP season, and a sub-17% strikeout rate that would be a career low, Harper is backing up every bold offseason declaration with his bat.

quotes.text: Harper is hitting like an MVP right now. Credit where it's due.
From literally the worst to literally the best in the last week.
He's unplayable right now. Alec Bohm is just unplayable.
quotes.source_hint: talk-radio host (WIP High Hopes), relaying Jason Stark's assessment

quotes.text: This is extremely worrisome. Your top prospect, a guy you've refused to trade... still not swinging a bat.
quotes.source_hint: Hittin' Season host on Aiden Miller

vibe_summary: Phillies fans are cautiously re-energized by a blazing rotation and a gritty winning streak, but a silent top prospect and an unplayable third baseman are keeping full optimism at arm's length.
reasoning: The dominant mood driver is the dramatic pitching turnaround — going from the worst rotation ERA in baseball to the best in under two weeks has genuine excitement flowing. Bryce Harper's MVP-caliber stretch adds to the lift. However, two clouds hang over the good feelings: Alec Bohm's historic slump has no clear resolution, and the Aiden Miller back situation is drawing serious long-term concern, with the fan analyst drawing explicit comparisons to careers cut short by spinal injuries. The overall tone sits well above the despair of late April, but the structural holes in the lineup and the prospect health scare prevent full-throated postseason conviction — what's present is relief and momentum, not deep belief in an October run.
